name: Contingency

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a gem-encrusted statuette of yourself worth 1,500+ GP

summary: Store a spell of level 5 or lower that goes off by itself when a condition you describe happens.
text: The stored spell takes an action to cast and must be able to target you; it takes effect only on you. Only one Contingency works at a time, and it ends if the statuette leaves your person.
